test_cases.title: Customer home page renders core conversion paths
test_cases.description: Verify the home page loads without console errors and exposes route search, fare discovery, phone, WhatsApp, and booking calls to action.

steps.description: Open the home page at the configured base URL
Page has one meaningful H1, brand name, hero content, and no uncaught console error
Call, WhatsApp, and booking links have valid destinations

test_cases.title: Customer marketing navigation reaches every primary section
test_cases.description: Verify header, footer, mobile navigation, and internal links reach routes, services, fleet, packages, about, contact, FAQ, privacy, and terms.

steps.description: Open the navigation at desktop width and visit every primary link
Repeat using the mobile navigation sheet
Each destination renders the intended page with no blank state or 404
Browser back and forward navigation preserve the correct page

test_cases.title: English and Hindi route parity
test_cases.description: Verify language switching preserves the current intent, renders Hindi localized paths, and keeps fare/business facts equivalent.

steps.description: Open an English route or package detail page
Switch to Hindi using the language control
Hindi page loads with Hindi copy, valid metadata, and an English alternate link
Displayed fare values and primary contact details match the English page

test_cases.title: Booking step one validates required route inputs
test_cases.description: Verify origin, destination, trip type, future date, pickup time, and passenger controls before moving to vehicle selection.

steps.description: Open the booking flow
Attempt to continue with empty route and invalid date fields
Inline errors or an accessible alert explain each invalid field and the step does not advance
Enter a valid route, one-way trip, future date, time, and passenger count
The flow advances to vehicle results

test_cases.title: Booking vehicle results enforce passenger capacity
test_cases.description: Verify vehicles below the passenger count are disabled and eligible vehicles show a fare.

steps.description: Search a route for the maximum passenger option
Vehicles with insufficient seats are visibly disabled and cannot be selected
Select an eligible vehicle
Fare summary shows total, advance, remaining amount, and vehicle name

test_cases.title: Booking supports round trips and night allowance
test_cases.description: Verify round-trip selection and night pickup times update the fare according to the fare contract.

steps.description: Select round trip and a nighttime pickup
The quote reflects the correct round-trip and night allowance rules
Switch to a daytime pickup
The night allowance is removed or changed according to the configured vehicle rule

test_cases.title: Booking rejects past dates and malformed customer data
test_cases.description: Verify the booking form cannot proceed with a past date, invalid name, invalid phone, or empty pickup point.

steps.description: Enter a past date and proceed
The date is rejected and the flow remains on the current step
Enter HTML in the name, alphabetic junk in phone, and empty pickup point
Validation feedback is visible and no booking request or confirmation is created

test_cases.title: Booking promo code states are safe and deterministic
test_cases.description: Verify a valid configured promo is applied once and unknown, expired, malformed, or repeated codes do not produce an invalid negative fare.

steps.description: Enter a valid promo code and calculate the fare
Discount is displayed once and total/advance/remaining remain non-negative
Replace it with an unknown, script-like, and repeated promo value
The UI shows a safe invalid/no-discount state without console errors

test_cases.title: Booking mock payment and confirmation
test_cases.description: Verify both mock payment options can complete the five-step flow and produce a ticket-like confirmation.

steps.description: Complete steps one through four with valid data
Choose UPI and submit the mock payment
Loading state prevents duplicate clicks and confirmation appears exactly once
Repeat in a clean session using card
A new confirmation is shown without leaking the previous session

test_cases.title: Booking back navigation preserves or safely resets state
test_cases.description: Verify Back returns to the prior step without corrupting fare state and changing route recomputes dependent results.

steps.description: Progress to customer details, then press Back twice
Earlier values are preserved where expected and no stale confirmation is shown
Change origin or destination and continue
Vehicle and fare results are recalculated for the new route

test_cases.title: Location autocomplete handles query, keyboard, empty, and failure states
test_cases.description: Verify autocomplete is usable by keyboard and handles short queries, no results, delayed results, and provider failure.

steps.description: Focus the location combobox and type a short query
The component exposes an accessible combobox/listbox relationship
Use ArrowDown and Enter to select a suggestion
The selected location is visible in the input
Test an unknown query and simulate a failed provider response
No-results and failure feedback is readable and does not crash the page

test_cases.title: Contact form validation and safe submission
test_cases.description: Verify contact/inquiry UI validates required fields, accepts valid data, and safely rejects XSS-like input.

steps.description: Submit an empty contact form
Required field errors are announced and submission is blocked
Enter valid name, phone, email, message, and trip interest
Submission shows a success state without exposing secrets
Repeat with script tags and event-handler payloads
Payload is rejected or safely rendered as text

test_cases.title: Deep links and not-found behavior
test_cases.description: Verify direct navigation and refresh work for known route, vehicle, and package paths and unknown paths show a useful not-found page.

steps.description: Open known detail URLs directly and refresh the browser
The correct detail page loads after refresh
Open an unknown URL
A useful 404 page appears with a working home link

test_cases.title: Responsive layout has no horizontal overflow
test_cases.description: Verify home, route, booking, and contact pages at 320px, 375px, 768px, and desktop widths.

steps.description: Measure key pages at each viewport width
No horizontal scrollbar or clipped primary action exists
Touch targets and form controls remain usable at mobile width

test_cases.title: Accessibility and reduced-motion behavior
test_cases.description: Verify keyboard-only operation, visible focus, labels, heading order, contrast, alt text, skip link, and reduced-motion handling.

steps.description: Navigate the home and booking flow using only keyboard
Focus is visible, logical, and never trapped
Enable prefers-reduced-motion and inspect animated areas
Motion is reduced and content remains available
Form errors use accessible names and live/alert semantics

test_cases.title: Customer site security and privacy smoke check
test_cases.description: Verify no private backend secrets are present in built assets and unsafe URL schemes are not emitted by CTA links.

steps.description: Inspect page source and loaded JavaScript for service-role keys, database URLs, payment secrets, or private tokens
No private credentials are present
Inspect telephone, WhatsApp, mail, and navigation href values
Only expected safe schemes and destinations are used

test_cases.title: Booking flow 3-second bank-grade pre-checkout encryption countdown overlay
test_cases.description: Verify clicking 'Proceed to Secure Payment' displays the 3-second bank-grade encryption countdown modal, updates step checkpoints, displays 28% advance due, and launches gateway or dismisses on cancel.

steps.description: Complete booking steps 1 through 4 and click Proceed to Secure Payment
BookingPaymentCountdownModal opens with role='dialog', 'BANK-GRADE ENCRYPTION' badge, and 3-second circular countdown
Modal displays locked server vehicle allocation, 28% advance deposit invoice generated, and Advance Due Today amount
Click 'Cancel and return to form'
Modal closes immediately and user remains on Step 4 without launching payment

test_cases.title: Booking flow 7-second dispatch verification countdown overlay and auto-redirect
test_cases.description: Verify that upon payment callback receipt, the 7-second dispatch verification countdown modal appears with emerald styling, ticket reference, and auto-redirects or allows immediate view confirmation bypass.

steps.description: Trigger successful mock payment callback in booking flow
BookingPaymentCountdownModal switches to verifying_payment stage with 'PAYMENT RECEIVED' badge, 7s countdown, and Booking Reference
Progress checkpoints update for digital payment signature, vehicle/chauffeur schedule, and official PDF pass generation
Click 'Click here to view confirmation now' or wait for timer completion
Browser redirects to /booking/confirmation/:id with verified status

test_cases.title: Booking confirmation page branded PDF voucher download and retry error handling
test_cases.description: Verify that the booking confirmation page presents the 'Download PDF Voucher' action (#btn-download-pdf-voucher), handles loading spinner state, and downloads the binary PDF.

steps.description: Open booking confirmation page with confirmed booking ticket ID
Status banner displays 'Booking Confirmed & Guaranteed' and '#btn-download-pdf-voucher' is visible and enabled
Click '#btn-download-pdf-voucher'
Button transitions to 'Generating PDF…' with spinning indicator
Browser downloads binary confirmation voucher PDF with ticket ID in filename

test_cases.title: Customer homepage static review marquee and review submission flow via token
test_cases.description: Verify that the homepage review marquee renders statically without runtime API calls and that /review/:token validates verified booking review submissions.

steps.description: Load homepage and inspect the Reviews marquee section
Marquee renders verified customer reviews statically with 5-star badges and zero fetch network errors
Navigate to /review/:token with valid invitation token
Review form pre-populates customer name, ticket ID, chauffeur name, and tour details
Select 5 stars, enter positive feedback text, and submit
Success confirmation is displayed and submission is received by backend moderation

test_cases.title: Extended fleet showroom with high-resolution dimensional photography and WhatsApp booking CTA
test_cases.description: Verify /fleet.html renders all 4 canonical groups, displays high-res dimensional vehicle photography, and provides working WhatsApp reservation links.

steps.description: Open /fleet.html and inspect vehicle cards across Sedan, SUV, Luxury, and Tempo Traveller groups
All vehicle images load successfully from /assets/fleet/ with zero 404s or fallback placeholder icons
Seating capacity, luggage allowance, and luxury features are displayed accurately for each model
Click the WhatsApp reservation CTA on a vehicle card
Generates valid WhatsApp URL containing the specific vehicle make and model name
